==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' with an optional feminine suffix {{m|sem-pro|*-at-}}: {{m|sem-pro|*warik(-at)-}}.

===Noun===
{{sem-noun|m|g2=f}}

# [[hip]], [[hipbone]]
# [[haunch]], upper [[thigh]]

{{sem-decl-noun}}
